main.description: A public statement signed by one of the user's own published public keys (dev.keytrace.userPublicKey).

content.description: The statement text that was signed.

createdAt.description: Datetime when this statement was created (ISO 8601).

keyRef.description: AT URI of the dev.keytrace.userPublicKey record whose private key produced this signature (e.g., at://did:plc:xxx/dev.keytrace.userPublicKey/3k4...)

retractedAt.description: Datetime when this statement was retracted. Present only if the statement has been retracted (ISO 8601).

sig.description: Cryptographic signature of the content field, produced by the key referenced in keyRef (PGP cleartext or detached, base64-encoded binary signature).

subject.description: Optional short subject or title for the statement.
